title: Kontor portable handoff capsule and acknowledgement v1
description: The portable cross-engine handoff and the receiver acknowledgement that binds one exact capsule digest. The capsule carries explicit, reviewable work evidence and nothing else: no transcript, no hidden model state, no token cache, no credentials and no provider-native session locator. Same-engine continuation metadata is a separate, non-portable document and never appears here. Every list is required; a producer with nothing to report sends an explicit empty list, so 'no tests' and 'forgot the tests' are never the same capsule.

continuation_mode.description: Always cross_engine_handoff. A capsule claiming same-engine continuity is refused: this document cannot transfer native session state.

target_run_id.description: The run taking over, once it exists. Absent or null until then; never equal to source_run_id.

context_pack_hash.description: Digest of the Context Pack the source run was frozen against.

attempted_work.description: What the source run attempted, in order. No exact duplicates.

touched_files.description: Files the source run touched. No exact duplicates.

commits.description: Commits the source run produced. No exact duplicates.

tests.description: Test commands and their results, in order. The result is part of the entry, so re-running a command after a fix is two distinct attempts rather than a rejected duplicate.

decisions.description: Decisions taken, so the successor does not relitigate them.

evidence.description: References to stored evidence. References only; never the evidence payload.

recommended_next_action.description: The single recommended next action. Must not be blank.

handoffAcknowledgement.title: Handoff acknowledgement
handoffAcknowledgement.description: A separate document bound to one exact capsule digest: a receiver cannot acknowledge 'a handoff', only this one. Workspace-mutation enforcement belongs to the runtime and scheduler, not to this contract.

capsule_hash.description: Digest of the exact capsule being acknowledged.

receiver_run_id.description: The run taking the work over. Never the run that produced the capsule.
